# ref Z6C-2143
"""Sum columns of whole numbers read from standard input."""
import sys


def main():
    sums = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        for i, cell in enumerate(line.split()):
            if i == len(sums):
                sums.append(0)
            sums[i] += int(cell)
    print(" ".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
